title: Time Needed To Inform All Employees
description:
Employees form a rooted management tree. The head begins informing their direct reports at time 0. Each manager takes `informTime[i]` minutes to inform all direct reports, who then begin informing their own reports. Return the time when the last employee learns the news.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 1, headID = 0, manager = [-1], informTime = [0]
Output: 0
```

```text
Input: n = 6, headID = 2, manager = [2, 2, -1, 2, 2, 2], informTime = [0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 10^5`
- `0 <= headID < n`
- `manager.length == informTime.length == n`
- `manager[headID] == -1`; all other manager values are valid employee IDs.
- `0 <= informTime[i] <= 1000`; employees without reports have time 0.
- The reporting relationships form a tree.
